text:
anna: Heads-up I'm in Berlin-Mitte tomorrow for a half-day meetup. Need quick lunch recs around Torstraße/Oranienburger Str for mixed diets.
marc: Curry 36 is a bit south but classic. Fast.
felix: For sit-down, Monsieur Vuong (viet) is solid and quick.
lena: There's a small spot called Deli4U on Torstraße that does great grain bowls (vegan-friendly).
mika: If you want schnitzel, Zur kleinen Markthalle has good portions and not too touristy.
anna: Any gluten-free options?
lena: Deli4U and Monsieur Vuong both have GF rice options. Ask about soy marinades at Vuong.
marc: Budget-friendly and fast: Mustafa's Gemüse Kebap is a walk but super popular for takeaway.
anna: Poll: react with emoji — :meat_on_bone: for schnitzel (Zur kleinen), :bowl_with_spoon: for bowls (Deli4U), :hot_pepper: for kebab (Mustafa's), :rice: for Vietnamese (Monsieur Vuong).
lunchbot: Poll created. React to vote. (auto)
felix: :rice:
lena: :bowl_with_spoon:
mika: :meat_on_bone:
marc: :hot_pepper:
anna: Currently looks tied across options. I'll aim for Deli4U if we want quick sit-and-eat, or Mustafa's for takeaway and eat in the park.
lena: I can swing by and grab a table if you want to meet there.
anna: Thanks! Will post exact meetup spot and time once I confirm end time of meeting.
